scope: Discovery-only inventory of image-based UI, logos, title/menu labels, texture banners, rasterized credits/signage candidates, and their reinsertion containers.

japanese_text_status_meaning.yes: filename/container evidence is direct enough to treat Japanese raster text as present
japanese_text_status_meaning.likely: strong semantic evidence; visual confirmation deferred
japanese_text_status_meaning.no: semantics indicate non-Japanese or non-text art; visual pass may overturn

format_notes.WTMD: Header-confirmed proprietary texture wrapper. Width/height are big-endian at 0x08/0x0A; GX/palette codes at 0x0C/0x0D.
format_notes.CXD: Most sampled files are Nintendo LZ10 wrappers; inventory records the declared uncompressed size and inner prefix magic without writing decompressed files.
format_notes.RTDP_VOL: Nested members are addressed by physical archive, archive_identity chain, entry index, and member name from the existing audit catalog.
format_notes.TPL: Nintendo texture container. Pixel metadata was intentionally deferred because no TPL decode was run.
format_notes.Wii_banner: opening.bnr contains IMET/IMD5 and banner.bin/icon.bin/sound.bin resource names; Sys/system.vol::banner.bin begins with WIBN.
format_notes.SFD: CRI movie container; frame inspection and baked-subtitle detection are deferred.
